supportPolicy.scope: Exact tuples only; an unlisted or drifted component is unsupported until separately qualified.
supportPolicy.projectExecution: No project runner is currently supported. Docker is never an evaluated-project sandbox.
supportPolicy.composeRole: Docker Compose is allowed only for the disposable local OpenBox system plane used by governed runs.
supportPolicy.production: No production credential, endpoint, provider, audit upload, deployment, or external control-plane write is supported.
supportPolicy.retention: redacted_digests only; raw content may exist in memory until finalization but is never persisted or hashed when it contains a known credential
supportPolicy.processLimit: maxProcesses=32 is bound and reported in historical evidence but is not hard-enforced by any rejected native tuple

openboxSystem.cleanup: zero run-owned containers, volumes, networks, listeners, and loaded Ollama models

unsupported.reason: The declared TCP bind rule permits 0.0.0.0 as well as loopback, the profile permits reads outside the snapshot, the reviewed launcher dropped the declared snapshot CWD, and Node 22 outside the claimed tuple produced a verified pack. The CWD defect is fixed, but the confinement and runtime tuple remain unsupported.
The exact standalone sandbox exposed every loopback port when local binding was enabled, so parent and child both reached the unapproved listener.
The pinned binary is absent and the retained exact probe did not prove kernel network confinement of the Claude parent.
The installed binary is version and digest drift and was not silently substituted for the pinned tuple.
Affected packages compile for Linux and Windows, but no native sandbox, project, model, or governed runtime tuple was executed there. Compile-only evidence is not support.
unsupported.evidence: phase logs and affected package compile gates

unsupported.reason: No compatibility inference, driver switch, SDK fork, model substitution, or platform generalization is allowed while there are zero supported tuples.

limits: There is no current supported project-runner tuple; the former Darwin arm64 Codex tuple is retained only as withdrawn historical evidence.
The native sandbox does not hard-enforce maxProcesses=32; process-group timeout and cleanup are not relabeled as a count ceiling.
The local Ollama daemon and source-built OpenBox images pre-existed the final matrix and are not project-sandbox components.
The governed pack pair is one observed pair; the five-run baseline distribution does not imply five governed blocks.
No production, paid, external-provider, Docker-project-sandbox, publish, deploy, or audit-upload claim is made.
